## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, change and user-visible result.

## Validation

List checks actually run and material limitations. Provider fixtures do not count as live smoke tests. Never include credentials or private inputs.

## Manual testing plan

Describe desktop/phone and agent/API steps relevant to the change, including failure/recovery behavior where applicable.

## Catalog, money or security impact

Record changed exact variants/regions, price/source evidence, admission/settlement behavior or authorization boundaries. Leave a brief "None" when irrelevant.
